definitionZh: n. 财物, 个人财产\n[经] 动产, 财物

example.text: After the fire, she returned to the apartment to collect her personal effects.
example.translationZh: 火灾过后，她回到公寓收拾自己的个人物品。

definitionEn: a. being effective without wasting time or effort or expense
definitionZh: a. 有效率的, 能干的

example.text: The new manager introduced an efficient system that cut processing time in half.
example.translationZh: 新经理引入了一套高效的系统，将处理时间缩短了一半。

definitionEn: n. an inflated feeling of pride in your superiority to others\nn. (psychoanalysis) the conscious mind
definitionZh: n. 自我\n[医] 自我

example.text: Winning the award really boosted his ego.
example.translationZh: 赢得这个奖项确实增强了他的自尊心。

definitionEn: n. a native or inhabitant of Egypt\nn. the ancient and now extinct language of Egypt under the Pharaohs; written records date back to 3000 BC\na. of or relating to or characteristic of Egypt or its people or their language
definitionZh: n. 埃及人\na. 埃及的, 埃及人的

example.text: The museum has a large collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts.
example.translationZh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量古埃及文物。

definitionEn: v. put out or expel from a place\nv. leave an aircraft rapidly, using an ejection seat or capsule
definitionZh: vt. 逐放, 放逐, 喷射\n[化] 排出

example.text: The pilot had to eject from the burning jet seconds before it crashed.
example.translationZh: 飞行员不得不在喷气式飞机坠毁前几秒从燃烧的飞机中弹射出来。

definitionEn:
v. t. To increase; to add to; to augment; -- now commonly used
   with out, the notion conveyed being to add to, or piece out by a
   laborious, inferior, or scanty addition; as, to eke out a scanty supply
   of one kind with some other.
adv. In addition; also; likewise.
n. An addition.
definitionZh: vt. 补充, 增加

example.text: The family had to eke out a meager living by selling vegetables at the local market.
example.translationZh: 这家人只能靠在当地市场卖菜勉强维持生计。

definitionEn:
v. add details, as to an account or idea; clarify the meaning of and discourse in a learned way, usually in writing
v. produce from basic elements or sources; change into a more developed product
v. work out in detail
s. marked by complexity and richness of detail
definitionZh: a. 精细的, 详尽的, 精心计划(或制作)的\nvt. 详细地说明, 用心地制作, 发挥\nvi. 变复杂, 作详细说明

example.text: Could you elaborate on your proposal so the whole team understands the plan?
example.translationZh: 你能详细说明一下你的提案，让整个团队都理解这个计划吗？

phrase.translationZh: 详细阐述；对……作进一步说明

definitionEn: v. pass by
definitionZh: vi. 逝去, 过去\nn. 逝去, 过去

example.text: Several years elapsed before they met again.
example.translationZh: 好几年过去了，他们才再次相见。

definitionEn: n. a fabric made of yarns containing an elastic material\na. capable of resuming original shape after stretching or compression; springy\ns. able to adjust readily to different conditions
definitionZh: n. 松紧带, 橡皮筋\na. 有弹性的, 能伸缩的, 可通融的

example.text: She stretched the elastic band until it snapped.
example.translationZh: 她把橡皮筋拉长，直到它啪的一声断了。

definitionEn: a. exultantly proud and joyful; in high spirits\ns. full of high-spirited delight
definitionZh: a. 兴高采烈的

example.text: She felt elated when she heard the news of her acceptance into the program.
example.translationZh: 听到自己被该项目录取的消息时，她感到兴高采烈。

definitionEn:
n. hinge joint between the forearm and upper arm and the corresponding joint in the forelimb of a quadruped
n. a sharp bend in a road or river
n. a length of pipe with a sharp bend in it
n. the part of a sleeve that covers the elbow joint
definitionZh: n. 手肘, 弯头, 扶手\nv. 用手肘推开, 推挤

example.text: The new office gives everyone a bit more elbow room.
example.translationZh: 新办公室给每个人都留出了更多活动空间。

definitionEn:
n. a person who is older than you are
n. any of numerous shrubs or small trees of temperate and subtropical northern hemisphere having white flowers and berrylike fruit
n. any of various church officers
s. used of the older of two persons of the same name especially used to distinguish a father from his son
definitionZh: n. 年长者, 老人, 前辈\na. 年长的, 资深的

example.text: My elder brother taught me how to ride a bicycle.
example.translationZh: 我哥哥教我骑自行车。

definitionEn: n people who are old collectively\ns advanced in years; (`aged' is pronounced as two syllables)
definitionZh: a. 过了中年的, 稍老的

example.text: The elderly often need help with everyday tasks.
example.translationZh: 老年人常常在日常事务上需要帮助。

definitionEn: a. relating to or concerned with electricity
definitionZh: a. 电的, 有关电的\n[医] 电的

example.text: He studied electrical engineering at university and now designs circuits for a living.
example.translationZh: 他在大学学习电气工程，现在以设计电路为生。

definitionEn: n. a person who installs or repairs electrical or telephone lines
definitionZh: n. 电学家, 电气技师, 电工\n[化] 电工; 电气工人

example.text: The lights in the kitchen stopped working, so we had to call an electrician.
example.translationZh: 厨房的灯不亮了，所以我们只好请电工来。

definitionEn: n. a physical phenomenon associated with stationary or moving electrons and protons\nn. energy made available by the flow of electric charge through a conductor\nn. keen and shared excitement
definitionZh: n. 电, 电流, 电学, 热情, 电力供应\n[化] 电学; 电

example.text: The new solar panels can generate enough electricity to power the entire building.
example.translationZh: 新的太阳能电池板能产生足够的电力为整栋大楼供电。

definitionEn: a. of or relating to electronics; concerned with or using devices that operate on principles governing the behavior of electrons\na. of or concerned with electrons
definitionZh: a. 电子的\n[计] 电子工业协会接口

example.text: She bought a small electronic device to track her daily steps.
example.translationZh: 她买了一个小型电子设备来记录每天的步数。

definitionEn: n. the branch of physics that deals with the emission and effects of electrons and with the use of electronic devices
definitionZh: n. 电子学\n[计] 电子学

example.text: The company is a leading manufacturer of consumer electronics such as smartphones and laptops.
example.translationZh: 这家公司是智能手机和笔记本电脑等消费电子产品的领先制造商。
